oracleBackup.authorityUnavailable: Local signing data is unavailable. Keep the saved oracle records and use the original key where available.
oracleBackup.needsRestore: Local signing data needs restoration. Restore the original backup before choosing an outcome.
oracleBackup.heading: Oracle backups
oracleBackup.description: List and restore encrypted oracle backups with the original local Nostr key. Retry uses the saved original destinations.
oracleBackup.staleRisk: An older restored copy can sign another outcome. Use one current copy. Relays may retain older encrypted versions after a deletion request.
oracleBackup.noRelays: No original relays are configured. Backup delivery is unavailable.
oracleBackup.importIncomplete: Import is incomplete. Restore the same version again before signing.
oracleBackup.preparationPending: Backup preparation is pending. Use the original local oracle key to retry.
oracleBackup.initialProgress: Initial backup acknowledged by {{count}} of {{total}} relays.
oracleBackup.terminalProgress: Terminal replacement acknowledged by {{count}} of {{total}} relays.
oracleBackup.deletionProgress: Old-version deletion acknowledged by {{count}} of {{total}} relays. This does not prove erasure.
oracleBackup.commitPending: Local terminal backup update is pending. Retry the saved backup.
oracleBackup.resolutionRelayConfirmed: The signed resolution has a retained relay acknowledgment.
oracleBackup.enginePending: Exact resolution synchronization with the original engine is pending.
oracleBackup.immutableOutcome: The first saved outcome on this device cannot change.
oracleBackup.failed: The action did not complete. Check the local status and retry. Saved oracle data remains available.
oracleBackup.sourceRefused: This version was not imported. This device has a saved terminal backup retry that cannot accept another source version. Your local oracle record and exact retry remain available.
oracleBackup.keyRequired: Listing and restore require the original local Nostr key. NIP-07 extensions cannot decrypt these private backups. Saved exact retries do not require a signer.
oracleBackup.discoveryLimit: Discovery depends on each relay. A page or an empty result cannot prove that all backups were found. Try another relay or restore an exact event ID.
oracleBackup.incompleteDiscovery: This page is incomplete. Refresh, try another relay, or use exact-ID restore.
oracleBackup.empty: No valid backup was returned on this page.
oracleBackup.unavailable: Original oracle metadata is unavailable. Restore its backup before preparing a new backup.
